capabilities.target: packaged CLI specification, project Forme config/content, deploy inputs, user plugin trust store, one explicitly selected local plugin package, and installed project plugin snapshots with grants
capabilities.justification: Loads the declarative CLI Builder specification, selected project/deploy inputs, bounded local plugin snapshots, and exact manifest-bound persisted trust decisions.

capabilities.target: dynamic plugin grant: non-reserved configured project storage paths and non-reserved absolute user paths requested under storage:read or filesystem:user
capabilities.justification: Supplies the product-side adapter only after the plugin host validates a persisted manifest-bound grant and path shape; project reads are containment checked and all reads are identity checked.

capabilities.target: dynamic plugin grant: non-reserved directories beneath the configured project storage root requested under storage:read
capabilities.justification: Enumerates only containment-checked project directories after the plugin host authorizes the requesting installed plugin.

capabilities.target: selected Forme project root excluding generated output, cache, dependency, and VCS trees
capabilities.justification: Coalesces authored project changes into conservative full-pipeline preview rebuilds.
The watch command serves successful in-memory preview artifacts and live-reload events on loopback.

capabilities.target: configured cache/DeployArtifact paths and identity-checked plugin installation transaction paths beneath the project root
capabilities.justification: Implements containment-checked forme clean and removes only installer stages, backups, and locks owned by the current transaction.

capabilities.target: dynamic plugin grant: non-reserved singly linked regular files beneath the configured project storage root requested under storage:write
capabilities.justification: Removes a contained project file only after the plugin host validates the installed plugin's manifest-bound storage:write grant.

capabilities.target: configured project cache, build-to-deploy input, selected filesystem deploy root, project forme-plugins root, and user-selected deterministic report
capabilities.justification: Persists cache entries, deploy state and reports, and atomically publishes a reviewed plugin snapshot with host-owned grants.

capabilities.target: dynamic plugin grant: non-reserved configured project storage files and non-reserved absolute user files requested under storage:write or filesystem:user
capabilities.justification: Writes only through no-follow, regular-file-checked adapters after the plugin host validates a persisted manifest-bound grant.

capabilities.target: configured project cache, deploy-input staging, filesystem/plugin publication transaction paths, and report parents
capabilities.justification: Creates cache shards and explicitly selected deploy, plugin-install, and report transaction paths.

capabilities.target: dynamic plugin grant: non-reserved configured project storage paths and non-reserved absolute user files requested under storage:write or filesystem:user
capabilities.justification: Creates project directories or regular files only after the plugin host validates the installed plugin's manifest-bound grant.
Inspects and publishes the explicitly configured GitHub Pages source ref through the reviewed Git Data API boundary.

capabilities.target: dynamic plugin grant: origins named by network:<host> or network:<scheme>:<host>
capabilities.justification: Performs bounded fetches only after the plugin host authorizes every initial and redirected origin against the installed plugin's manifest-bound grants.

capabilities.target: dynamic plugin grant: hosts named by network:<host> or network:<scheme>:<host>
capabilities.justification: Host resolution is an unavoidable part of the separately authorized plugin fetch adapter and never occurs before the plugin host validates the requested hostname.
Reads the sole supported hosted-deploy credential only for a real GitHub Pages publication.

capabilities.target: dynamic plugin grant: variable names approved as env:<name>
capabilities.justification: Reads an exact environment variable only after the plugin host matches it against the installed plugin's persisted manifest-bound grant.

capabilities.target: npm install for local file dependencies and the native Forme sandbox supervisor plus configured plugin runtime
capabilities.justification: The repository-only bootstrap helper installs local file dependencies in deterministic leaf-first order; StageRef execution delegates verified snapshots only through an attested platform sandbox.
Observes interactive and CI termination and propagates cooperative cancellation through builds and deploys.
Prints command summaries and stable machine-coded diagnostics for terminal and CI consumers.

justification: The CLI loads project, deploy, and explicitly selected local plugin inputs; creates bounded build/deploy/install state; publishes only through reviewed adapters; provides explicit grant-mediated plugin storage, network, environment, and user-filesystem backends; handles cooperative cancellation; and provides the repository bootstrap helper.
